assessments.task: Find the thin bridge between the two unequal thyroid lobes and follow it across the U-shaped recess in this case-specific exterior.

axes.observation: Clean reimport preserves triangle correspondence to the s0189 source-frame export. The largest movement was 0.609 mm overall and 0.279 mm in the central band around the vulnerable bridge. The outline and continuity are visible on both sides. The superficial smoothing is editorial and same-case tracheal context is absent.

The oblique and reverse silhouettes retain the narrow bridge and unequal lobes. The matched detail shows softer superficial ridges and a broad source depression that remains visible. Those views use the original rose material. A neutral-material check of the remaining depressions at close range is missing.

The oblique overview shows both unequal lobes and the short bridge below the deep recess. Reversing the view keeps that bridge continuous between the lobes. The older grayscale check covers the oblique pair only. Orientation is relative to the retained export and has no same-case trachea landmark.

One continuous mesh and one primitive preserve the thin bridge without artificial selection seams. The illustration uses 8,340 triangles and 152,124 bytes, versus 8,340 and 151,580 for the same-scope source. The change is surface smoothing. The bridge contour has yet to be tested at a lower triangle count.
